title: A finite-length module has a filtration with simple quotients
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $M$ an $R$-module. Define the module length as the supremum of the numbers of proper inclusions in strict chains of $R$-submodules (Stacks Tags 02LY and 00IV), and assume this supremum is finite. Then there are an integer $r\ge0$ and strict inclusions $0=M_0\subsetneq M_1\subsetneq\cdots\subsetneq M_r=M$ such that each quotient $M_i/M_{i-1}$ is nonzero and has no proper nonzero $R$-submodule.
